visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with black hair and a white T-shirt stands in a brightly lit indoor studio. He speaks directly to the camera with a smiling, friendly expression while gesturing with his hands. (2) He holds a black makeup compact from the brand KAIBEAUTY toward the camera, opening it to show two shades of eyebrow powder. (3) The man looks into a small handheld mirror while using a brush to apply powder to his left eyebrow. The background remains a softly lit indoor room with neutral tones. (4) He switches to a thin black eyebrow pencil, drawing fine strokes on his eyebrow. A circular magnification graphic highlights the detail of the application. (5) He uses a mascara wand to brush through his eyebrow hairs in an upward motion to set them. (6) The subject poses with both eyebrows finished, showing a confident and happy expression. He then holds the compact, the pencil, and the mascara together in front of his face for a final product shot.
